    n = int(data[0])
    table = [[0]*(n+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    index = 1
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            table[i][j] = int(data[index])

    MAXN = (1 << 20) + 7
    MAXK = 20
    INF = int(1e9) + 7
    LLINF = int(1e18) + 7
    EPS = 1e-9
    MOD = int(1e9) + 7

    maska = [0] * MAXN
    for i in range(1, 7):
        for j in range(i+1, 7):
            for k in range(j+1, 7):
                maska[(1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k)] = (1 << ((i-1)*3 + (j-1)*3 + (k-1)))

    for i in range(n+1, 7):
        table[i][i] = 100

    edges = []
    for i in range(1, 7):
        for j in range(1, 7):
            edges.append((i, j))
    def power(base, exponent):
        result = 1
        while exponent > 0:
            if exponent & 1:
                result = (result * base) % MOD
            base = (base * base) % MOD
            exponent >>= 1
        return result

    inv_100 = power(100, MOD - 2)

    dp = [[0]*(2) for _ in range(1 << 20)]

    def compute_mask(edges_list, flag):
        mask_value = 0
        length = len(edges_list)
        for i in range(length):
            for j in range(i+1, length):
                if edges_list[i][0] != edges_list[j][0] and edges_list[i][1] != edges_list[j][1]:
                    for k in range(j+1, length):
                        if (edges_list[i][0] != edges_list[k][0] and edges_list[j][0] != edges_list[k][0] and
                            edges_list[i][1] != edges_list[k][1] and edges_list[j][1] != edges_list[k][1]):
                            mask_value |= maska[(flag ^ ((1 << edges_list[i][1]) - 1) | (1 << edges_list[j][1]) - 1 | (1 << edges_list[k][1]) - 1)]
        return mask_value

    for k in range(2):
        for mask_idx in range(1 << 18):

            current_mask = compute_mask(selected_edges, k)
            dp[current_mask][k] = (dp[current_mask][k] + prob) % MOD

    result = 1
    for i in range(20):
        for j in range(1 << 20):

    for i in range(1 << 20):

    print((result + MOD) % MOD)
